segments.sn35.152:1.1: “Sace vo, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ –
segments.sn35.152:1.3: Evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe, bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyātha –
segments.sn35.152:1.4: ‘dukkhassa kho, āvuso, pariññāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī’ti.
segments.sn35.152:1.5: Sace pana vo, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ –
segments.sn35.152:1.6: ‘katamaṃ panāvuso, dukkhaṃ, yassa pariññāya samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatī’ti?
segments.sn35.152:1.7: Evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe, bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyātha –
segments.sn35.152:2.9: Yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhaṃ;
segments.sn35.152:2.10: tassa pariññāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussati … pe … jivhā dukkhā … mano dukkho;
segments.sn35.152:2.13: tassa pariññāya bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussati … pe … yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi dukkhaṃ;
segments.sn35.152:2.18: Evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe, bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyāthā”ti.

lines: Te naṃ samudācarantīti te etaṃ adhibhavanti ajjhottharanti sikkhāpenti vā.
“Evaṃ vejjakammaṃ karohi, evaṃ dūtakamman”ti iti sikkhāpanasaṅkhātena samudācaraṇatthenassa te ācariyā nāma honti, tehi ācariyehi sācariyakoti vuccati.
151-152. Anta-saddo samīpatthe vattati “udakantaṃ vanantan”tiādīsu, kileso pana atiāsanne vasati abbhantaravuttitāyāti “antevāsikan”ti vutto vibhattialopena yathā “vanekusalo, kūlerukkhā”ti.
Anto assa vasantīti assa puggalassa anto abbhantare citte vasanti pavattanti.
Te etaṃ adhibhavantīti te kilesā etaṃ puggalaṃ abhibhavitvā attano vase vattenti.
Tehi ācariyehīti tehi kilesasaṅkhātehi satte attano gatiyaṃ ṭhapentehi ācariyehi.
Sattamaṃ heṭṭhā kathitanayamevāti yasmā heṭṭhā khandhavasena desanā āgatā, idha āyatanavasenāti ayameva viseso.
